content.comment_body: Does the [product_name] 8 support DHCP or is only static IP address assignment available? Model: [article_no]
[product_name] does not support DHCP. You'll need to assign a static IP address.

Correct, DHCP is not supported directly by [product_name]. Alternatively, you can connect the device to a separate router’s LAN port, with the router’s WAN port attached to your main network. The router’s DHCP could then assign network IPs. Additionally, port forwarding may be used to route traffic as needed. For example, if the device has IP 192.168.1.10 and uses port 8080, and your main network uses subnet 192.168.2.XXX, but you want to access it via port 10001: - Set up the additional router with IP 192.168.1.1 - Connect your device to the router’s LAN and set its gateway to 192.168.1.1 - Configure the router to forward port 10001 (WAN) to IP 192.168.1.10, port 8080 This way, your network integration can be achieved via routing and port forwarding.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to know if [product_name] 8 supports DHCP. Responses clarify that only static IP configuration is available and DHCP is not supported natively. Alternative networking methods using routers and port forwarding are suggested, implying that DHCP support is a common requirement for easier network integration but is missing from the device.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects native DHCP support for simpler IP address assignment and plug-and-play network integration, aiming to minimize manual network configuration tasks.
